text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.
reply_text:
@Sofia, it was **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living). The Feb 17 #coastal-team thread has you and Kwame confirming that the retail account, the PHL with the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments, is the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, and the door 6 lamp delivery wasn't on it. Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail the day before that thread, so the old name may still show up in older records.

Source: #coastal-team, Feb 17 (gbrain, `heldout/chats/2026-02-17-phl-collision`)
